intro: Shay Leafrunner, once found, asks you to help her get back to her friend Rockbiter. She admits she wanders off whenever there is something to see, but she has a bell whose sound brings her running back.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Do you think you could help me find my way back to my friend, Rockbiter? He was supposed to be watching me... But I do have a tendency to wander off now and then. There are just so many things to see, and I get so distracted.
There is one thing that will always work to get my attention, though.
Inside this chest, you'll find a bell that is very precious to me. I just love the sound of it. You have my word, if I wander off, all you have to do is ring it and I'll come running back.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I was gettin' worried 'bout ya! Thank you so much for bringin' Shay home, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: What? You say dis bell will work when Shay runs off? Well, how 'bout that!
Since you did so much fer me, here ya go, friend.
